assumptions: Tier 1 assumes: Cloud Storage Standard class in a us-central1 regional bucket with a flat namespace, reached through the XML API (the S3-compatible API ClickHouse uses); soft delete, Object Versioning, Autoclass, website configuration and Requester Pays off; no credits or committed-use discounts; Hyperdisk Balanced only; VM↔Cloud Storage transfer in the same region free; VM↔VM across zones of the region per GiB, charged to the sending side; internet egress 0 by default.
Other configurations are unsupported, not approximated.

request_classes.note: pricing page, Standard storage in a region: 'Class A operations, flat namespace (per 1,000 operations)' $0.005. XML API Class A: 'GET Bucket (when listing objects in a bucket)', 'PUT', 'POST'. Multipart initiate and complete are POST, parts and copies are PUT. DeleteObjects is the XML API multi-object delete, a POST Bucket request (https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/xml-api/reference-methods); the page names no exception for it, so it is billed as Class A.

pricing page: 'Class B operations, flat namespace (per 1,000 operations)' $0.0004. XML API Class B: 'GET Bucket (when retrieving bucket configuration or when listing ongoing multipart uploads)', 'GET Object', 'HEAD'. ListParts is a GET Object request ('List Object Parts', https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/xml-api/reference-methods).
pricing page: XML API free operations: 'DELETE'. AbortMultipartUpload is a DELETE Object request ('Abort a multipart upload', https://cloud.google.com/storage/docs/xml-api/reference-methods).

outcome_billing.note: pricing page: 'Generally, you are not charged for operations that return 307, 4xx, or 5xx responses. The exception is 404 responses returned by buckets with Website Configuration enabled and the NotFoundPage property set to a public object in that bucket.' Tier 1 assumes no website configuration, so every 4xx is free. The dropped entry is the same model assumption as for AWS.

units_evidence.note: pricing page: 'Azure Blob Storage usage is calculated in binary Gigabytes (GB), where 1 GB = 2^30 bytes. ... Similarly, 1 TB is 2^40 bytes, i.e. 1,024 GBs.'

assumptions: Tier 1 assumes: Blob Storage general-purpose v2 account, Hot tier, LRS, flat namespace (no hierarchical namespace), East US; each S3 call ClickHouse makes is priced as its Blob REST counterpart; blob soft delete, versioning, index tags and reservations off; no credits; Premium SSD v2 only; VM↔Blob transfer in the same region free; cross-AZ VM↔VM per GB in each direction; internet egress 0 by default.
Other configurations are unsupported, not approximated.

request_classes.note: price list, Hot LRS: 'Hot LRS Write Operations' $0.05 per 10K; pricing page row 'Write operations (per 10,000)'. Mapping (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/map-rest-apis-transaction-categories): Put Blob, Copy Blob, Put Block, Put Block from URL and Put Block List are Write for standard general purpose v2.

price list: 'LRS List and Create Container Operations' $0.05 per 10K. Mapping: List Blobs and Create Container are 'List and create container'. ListMultipartUploads has no Blob counterpart; it is priced as List Blobs with uncommitted blobs, the nearest call.
price list: 'Hot Read Operations' $0.004 per 10K. Mapping: Get Blob is Read.

price list: 'All Other Operations' $0.004 per 10K; pricing page: 'All other Operations (per 10,000), except Delete, which is free'. Mapping: Get Blob Properties, Get Container Properties and Get Block List are Other. DeleteObjects is a Blob Batch: 'The Blob Batch REST request is counted as one transaction, and each individual subrequest is also counted as one transaction' (https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/rest/api/storageservices/blob-batch); the parent is Other, its Delete Blob subrequests are free.
pricing page: 'All other Operations (per 10,000), except Delete, which is free'. Mapping: Delete Blob is Free for standard general purpose v2.

Blob Storage has no call that starts or aborts a block upload: blocks are staged with Put Block and committed with Put Block List, and uncommitted blocks are garbage collected 'within a week following the last successful Put Block operation'. No request is sent.

outcome_billing.note: Storage Analytics status messages, column 'Billable': ThrottlingError (503), ServerTimeoutError and ServerOtherError (500) are 'No'; ClientOtherError ('many 300-400 level HTTP status codes and conditions such as NotFound'), NetworkError and ClientTimeoutError are 'Yes'. https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/azure/storage/blobs/map-rest-apis-transaction-categories: 'REST operations aren't billed when authentication fails. After an identity is authenticated, all operations and requests that the identity makes are billed, including the ones that don't succeed.' So 4xx is billed and dropped is billed: a client timeout or a closed connection is billable on Azure.
